company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. Its website describes it as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

The site's material includes work on artificial intelligence in a national security context. One report considers near-term opportunities for integrating agentic artificial intelligence capabilities across the Department of War. Another item discusses an upcoming Trump-Xi summit and the disappointment it is likely to bring to leaders of top AI labs that have called for urgent, coordinated pacing of frontier AI progress. A further item argues for lengthening the United States' AI lead by expanding rather than weakening technology protections, starting with closing three priority gaps: remote access and adversarial access among them.

The organization's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile lists Washington state as a location of law exposure, with a count of 114.
